protocol.code_path: production chunker, BM25Retriever, SemanticRetriever, HybridRetriever(rrf_k=60, default depth); exact in-memory search
protocol.document_rank: best-ranked chunk of each BEIR document
protocol.metrics: nDCG@10 (linear graded gain), Recall@100, MRR@10 on test qrels
protocol.tuning: none: production defaults, no parameter was fitted to these datasets
protocol.uncertainty: paired bootstrap at two levels: clusters (connected components of queries sharing a relevant document) and single queries; cluster level flagged uninformative below 30 clusters
